rows.text: The company has executed MOU for establishing a subsidiary Company

**completes the acquisition of 55% of Chhariot EMob**, an electric two-wheeler and EV-battery business, **for cash at face value**, with its own promoters taking the other 45% — which the annexure records as making it a related-party transaction.
